name: Tamaddun Majlish
contribution: This organization, led by Abul Kashem, launched one of the earliest structured campaigns for Bangla as a state language.
context: The first organized phase of the language movement after 1947.
impact: It gave the movement its initial intellectual framework and helped move the language question into public politics.
highlight: Tamaddun Majlish helped launch the organized campaign for Bangla as a state language after 1947.
seoTitle: Tamaddun Majlish: Early Language Movement Organization
seoDescription: Learn how Tamaddun Majlish and Abul Kashem helped organize the early campaign for Bangla as a state language.
shortAnswer: Tamaddun Majlish was an intellectual organization that helped initiate the organized Language Movement after 1947.
